name: par2
description: Parity archive tool for creating error-correcting recovery files to protect against data corruption

par2.description: Create and use parity files for error detection and correction to recover damaged or missing files
par2.usage:
par2 create archive.par2 file1.txt file2.txt
par2 verify archive.par2
par2 repair archive.par2
par2 create -r5 archive.par2 *.jpg
